notes.title: Refight :Burning Engine Closure Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players:
“Refight:Burning Engine” has been strongly supported by the majority of players since it was launched. We sincerely thank you for your love.

Due to major technical updates, we decided to stop the recharge service on May 23, 2022 .We will close the server and clear the account information on July 23, 2022 .

Sorry for the inconvenience. If you have any questions or suggestions on this matter, please feel free to communicate with our customer service team at any time.

Refight:Burning Engine Team
May 23, 2022

2、	Adjusted the novices guidance process.
3、	The Talent Accessory feature is temporarily offline and will be re-routed after subsequent refactoring.
4、	The challenge feature is temporarily offline and will be back online when subsequent refactoring is complete.
5、	The main interface of the hall adds a task center to quickly collect task rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/2d59d08ae4d2e62b0c598e01de94775fd679332e.png[/img]

7、	Combat equipment system optimization.
（1）	The durability of the equipment in the garage no longer affects the value of the equipment in combat.
（2）	The drop of equipment when a chariot is destroyed is no longer determined by rank, but by the durability of each piece of equipment. High durability into the battle will reduce the drop rate.
（3）	Damage to armor during combat no longer affects the durability of equipment in the garage.
（4）	The maintenance price of the armor was restored.
（5）	Increased silver revenue at battle settlement.
（6）	Removed the appearance and functionality of the external backpack. Currently, all vehicles enter the battle with a 6-pack slot by default. The player's previously purchased external backpack will return 3 times the silver, and the external backpack and exterior will return the required gold if purchased in gold.
8、	Warehouse added Quick Sale function, players can quickly sell the specified multiple equipment
9、	The Replace Load Box and Load Map features in the dress-up are temporarily offline.
10、	Joint action function optimized and reopened
a.	Equipment and props can be carried into the battlefield at the war readiness center and armored accessories will not fall after the chariot has been destroyed. Special ammunition and consumables will be lost after use and will need to be replenished in the next battle.
b.	The airdrop box contains ammunition, consumables, skill items and no armored accessories.
c.	Players can earn points by occupying resource points and destroying enemy targets. Our party is destroyed, self-destruction will be deducted points, the first to achieve the battlefield needs of the points will be won.
11、	Friends, chats, teams, check-in, tasks, activities appear to receive rewards when there will be a red dot prompt.
12、	Menu, mail interface UI, active UI optimization.
13、The armored interior thickness shows the UI.
14、The new model, "Single Training", which requires all equipment and ammunition to be explored in combat, does not bring in out-of-gear, silver-free rewards, no rank points, and supply box rewards.
15、Battlefield loading interface features are optimized.

notes.notes:
[b][h1]Maintenance time[/h1][/b]
1.11, 2020 16:00~20:00  Asia (UTC+8)
1.11, 2020 0:00~4:00   NA (UTC-8)
Specific maintenance time will be advanced or delayed as appropriate

[b][h1]Update content：[/h1][/b]
New gameplay and new features
1，Add the new Crew System. Players can view and assign crew skills (through combat) on the member screen, initially gaining 4 members directly. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/84996becf00c5c7c933ae5efe9ff9d182838e828.png[/img]
2，In the new vehicle Talent System, players can view and select vehicle talent from the talent interface. And they can choose one more talent for each level (full level is 7).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/a3a22394ff35ace281ff9c3299c9d9dd88c361cf.png[/img]
3，Add the Vehicle Equipment System. Players can view, upgrade and equip the equipment in it. (Different vehicles need to be purchased separately.) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/b9f5011de573cf10b7a58e3b9dd507549ba16372.png[/img]
4，The original vehicle proficiency modified is changed to the vehicle level and the original proficiency progress automatically converted to the vehicle private Skill Exp. Which it can be used to upgrade the vehicle level and equipment (The Skill Exp of different vehicles cannot be used universally.) 
5，Add 10 new Battle Pass levels, Golden Pass Rewards adds the new Member and Free-Skill Exp.

Adjustments and optimizations
1，Adjust the UI of part of the hall, add crew, talents and equipment entrance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/86f97fe50907cb40818727e6310bc9aaaecd6326.png[/img]
2，Optimize the relevant UI of centering and fill tips in the battle. So that it is more visible and accurate.
3，The driving system and engine in the vehicle internal structure are combined into the Power System. And the new observation port is added (the debuff that will cause the detection distance to be shortened by being broken).
4，Increase the single-shot damage and armor-piercing value of 75/76MM gun. And the clip capacity adjusted to 3 rounds (double clip for 6 rounds).
5，Optimize the mechanism of the magazine gun. For 75MM/76MM artillery and 100mm/105mm artillery (when equipped with double-magazine), the filling time will be determined according to the number of remaining shells actually filled (i.e. there are remaining shells in the barrel, filling time will be shortened accordingly).
6，Increase the penetration of HEAT to the body’s own armor slightly (not external armor).
7，Adjusted the process of the novice guide level.

Compensation
For players whose proficiency level has achieved level 7 or above when the proficiency system is updated in November, we will issue a proportional amount of Free-Skill Exp (received in email). Due to the large number of affected players, the distribution may be slow, please be patient. Thank you.

notes.title: Tron legacy-theme season:ammunition system
notes.notes:
[b][h1]New shells system[/h1][/b]
Tanke will have a certain amount of shells since the battle starts. And there will also be kinds of powerful shells scattered over the map, players should collect different shells according to the their tactics. Players can equio 2 kinds of ashells at most.Here are all informations about our new shells

[b][h1]Shells info[/h1][/b]
AP：Discription:Basic shell, armor piercing ability is general, medium damage, cause no damage when not piercing or after ricocheted
HE：Discription:Basic shell, no armor piercing ability, high damage, always can cause damage, damage is affected by armor
APHE：Discription:Advanced shell, have normal armor piercing ability, medium damage, always have damage, will cause tremendous damage after piercing the aromor
HEAT：Discription:Advanced shell, have strong armor piercing ability, medium damage,cause no damage when not piercing or after ricocheted
APFSDS：Discription:Ultimate shell, have the strongest armor piercing ability, high damage,cause no damage when not piercing or after ricocheted

Tanks can equip all guns in the new season.
Guns type:75/76mm gun,100/105mm gun,120/125mm gun.Availale shells for each gun

notes.title: Development note——scanning of landscape
notes.notes:
January 23rd still sunny
As the Spring Festival nears，I'm a little bit lazy and lack of vigour.And because I have brought you guys something hardcore before，let's lazily have a scan of new version's landscape today.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/3190921d135c7db51b837de78923ab38ebd74fda.jpg[/img]
	Helicopters will be new conveyance for tanks.It will be pretty cool to see each tank has its own helicopter up over the sky.And it will let players easier to take a bird's-eye view of the hole map.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/00b99d4b03a24656d22b1e26b8a91f29af0c1c57.jpg[/img]
	An American style logging camp with timber neatly stacked here brings people back to the America land in the reclamation period，a period full of wild nature，dangers and opportunities as well.Let's see what equipment you will pick up and what battles you will meet here.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/9ce2e6be4bf3ad2c785433e6907ef671e248c185.jpg[/img]
Simple pasture，clear pond，together will endless snow mountains make you feel at the foot of Alps and can't help singing.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/ba5b249f37f097be193a9187586625fc66365175.jpg[/img]
	Clouds are soft，sky is blue，mountains are endless，grass are so green.A railway pass through stretching itself into the distance.What a great scenery，too fantastic to please everyone. 
How beautiful time pass by！It's time to say goodbye again，see you next time.

notes.title: Development note——accuracy&armors
notes.notes:
January 18th Sunny
I bet you guys don't expect me appear again that soon.Actually，because of my numerous begging，one of our designers is finally willing to tell me something hardcore about new version.So here are big news I bring to you guys today. 
[b]Armors[/b]
  [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/f8898107554f7f4d459f9d99de98115730c424fc.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/7263bff75726b741a4facbe80cb5c3b9f9f17896.png[/img]
These two pictures show that different parts of tank’s and turret’s armors will be distinguished by different colors.It is said that different colors mean different thickness of armors.And only after piercing armors can players hurt tanks.
[b]Inter structure[/b]
  [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/e09d3e58f0b582fe3d2a2a95d7c4272cf89d0d68.png[/img]
We may introduce inter structure into our new version,and even more,the drivers.During battles,damage on different parts of tanks will cause different debuffs.For example,damage on ammunition rack may cause detonation,breechblock may influence firing.
[b]Adjustment on guns[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/3b4f78d6ac7db0d92569138327a14bbd464283e4.png[/img]
At last,the designer tells me that differences,such as damage and accuracy, between guns&guns,guns parts&guns parts will be amplified.And besides,different actions done by tanks will also have different impacts.All these adjustments will make our tanks control and game experience better.
So that’s all today,see ya next time.

notes.title: Research&development note—Mysterious forest
notes.notes:
January 10th  cloudy
It has been two months since 《refight：burning engine》（early access） landed steam. I have a impression that all the updates of our game are just somethings normal like new skins and battle pass.So I guess our game will make big noise—a big update—after such a long silent，especially considering the coming of the Spring Festival，Chinese biggest day.

Besides，I have also received lots of questions about our new version.But our game designers just don't speak even a word whatever I ask.So today I decide to have a search on designers’ computers when they are trapped in meeting.
[b]
Mysterious forest[/b]
A familiar as well as strange forest map come into sight when I turn on the computer.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/ed26f8f6b6ced56a7cdfeccc811f31c409d712bd.png[/img]
This map should be included in 《refight：burning engine》，but how can I haven’t seen it before？
Gazing into this original and wild forest，I bet you guys want to have an outing here now！
But in fact，this forest will must become a best area for sniping as dense forest is a natural barrier.I can feel it is so unfriendly to players like me who don't have sharp eyes.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/fdec7c237b9f917a29bf6fc35bd9b420ddc5405a.png[/img]
This downed helicopter also hints that this area is not that peaceful as it seems.An atmosphere of imminent war spread in the air.
Well,that’s all today because designers’ meeting is going to over.See you guys next time~
